id: title:TueHaulund:turn off unrunnable scanners that hit their credit limit

observations.behavior: Adds a helper function `unrunnable_reason` that checks two conditions: whether the organization has AI data processing approval and whether the scanner's creator retains access. It returns a reason string or None.
observations.posthog_connection: Checks a permission flag on the organization and a relationship status on the scanner to determine if a replay scanner can ever spend credits.

observations.behavior: Imports the new helper function and the scanner access module.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds a dependency on the new access control helper.

observations.behavior: Updates the database query to eagerly load the organization and creator, and adds a check using the new helper. If the helper returns a reason, the activity returns early without capping, allowing a downstream process to disable the scanner.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the budget check activity to identify scanners that cannot spend and return early, presumably to trigger a disable action elsewhere.
